principle: Text, image, video, graphics and audio must each carry visible provenance and lawful-use discipline.

visual_labels.ai_generated: AI-GENERATED ILLUSTRATION / ИЛУСТРАЦИЈА ГЕНЕРИРАНА СО AI

rights_rules: Do not remove or crop out watermarks or author/source credit.
Do not re-upload substantial third-party video where an official embed or link is available.
Do not reproduce agency photography/video (including Reuters, AP, AFP, Getty or similar) without an applicable licence or permission.
Public availability does not equal an open licence.
Use original WPA graphics, maps, timelines or clearly labelled AI illustrations when third-party visual rights are not available.
User-supplied visual material requires provenance, consent/right-to-use and authenticity review before publication.
AI-generated visuals must never be presented as documentary imagery from a real event.
